_readme: CANONICAL QA TEST DATA. This file is the single source of truth for docs/qa/MOCK_DATA_BOOK.md, scripts/qa-seed.mjs and the Playwright suite. Never hardcode test data in a spec file - add it here. Every record is synthetic; no real patient data may ever be placed in this file (DPDP Act 2023).

_labTestsNote: criticalLow/criticalHigh drive LabResultWorkspace.calcFlag() - CL when value < criticalLow, CH when value > criticalHigh, and CH/CL is the ONLY thing that raises a clinical_alerts critical row and blocks release. Without them a critical potassium reads as a plain 'H' and no alert ever fires (Phase 5 finding L3). category feeds lab_dual_validation_config's test_category match, which is case-sensitive. autoverifyEligible is opt-in per test and defaults to false in the database, so the auto-verification path is unreachable until it is seeded (finding L7).

phase2._note: Data the Phase 2 UI tests ENTER through the settings screens. Deliberately NOT seeded by scripts/qa-seed.mjs — if the seeder created these rows the entry tests would prove nothing. Keys match the route they are typed into. Every value is synthetic (DPDP Act 2023).

/settings/lab-tests._note: Must NOT be a name the default catalogue seeds — lab_test_master is unique on (hospital_id, test_name), so a create case pointed at a seeded test fails on the unique key rather than on the behaviour it is testing. dropdowns._note: Full option list for every settings dropdown/select/radio that offers a fixed, finite set of choices. The P2L exhaustive-dropdown-coverage tests cycle every value here, not just the one sample value in the entry block above. Values are the business-meaningful option (matching how this file documents drug_routes/drug_frequencies); e2e/phase-02-settings/settings-forms.ts maps any that render with a different visible label than the stored value (e.g. Interface Language 'Hindi' is stored as 'hi').

labTestWithoutRange._note: Also kept off the default catalogue — see the note on phase2.entry['/settings/lab-tests']. Serum Copper is a genuine trace-element assay, so the case still reads as a real test entered without a reference range rather than as obviously synthetic data.

phase4._note: Data the Phase 4 OPD tests TYPE IN. Patients are NOT created here — every scenario reuses a seeded PT-QA-NNNN record already tagged for it in MOCK_DATA_BOOK.md (PT-QA-0001 baseline/follow-up, 0003 appointment, 0004 TPA, 0005 PMJAY, 0006/0007 CGHS with/without referral, 0009 paediatric, 0010 polypharmacy, 0011 penicillin allergy, 0012 pregnant, 0013 partial payment, 0014 discount, 0032 MLC, 0036 physio). Doctors, fees and validity windows come from the `doctorFees` array above; vitals and discount percentages from `commonValues`. Every value is synthetic (DPDP Act 2023).
